caption: Actions for a published item in the authoring top bar
preconditions: Seeded data (SEED.md): CEASEFIRE-TALKS 'Talks on Dunmarra ceasefire to resume next week, mediators say' is published from desk World and shows in 'World desk output'
Admin has all privileges (rewrite, correct, takedown, unpublish, kill), so all five buttons show

double-click [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="World desk output"] [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Talks on Dunmarra ceasefire to resume next week, mediators say"]
wait for [data-test-id="authoring-topbar"] to be visible and for the button with aria-label 'Kill' inside it
notes: The item opens read-only (action 'view'). Buttons come from scripts/apps/authoring/views/authoring-topbar.html: Update, Correct, Takedown, Unpublish, Kill, each with aria-label equal to its text. Do not click any of them. If the top bar is too wide for a useful crop, crop to the right half of the top bar (the button stack .subnav__button-stack--default). Capture: while the monitoring list is visible the buttons collapse to their initials (U, C, T, UP, K) even at 1920 px, so the steps switch to Full width mode first; one outline marks the five buttons.

caption: Correcting a published item

Default client config: corrections_workflow off, so Correct opens the plain correction
steps: double-click [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Politics desk output"] [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Poll shows Civic Union narrowing gap to four points"]
click the button with aria-label 'Correct' inside [data-test-id="authoring-topbar"]
Change the headline in [data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="field--headline"] to 'Poll shows Civic Union narrowing gap to three points'

cleanup.script: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-test-id="unsaved-changes-dialog"] button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() === 'ignore'); if (b) { b.click(); } })()

notes: Plain correction (action 'correct'): the top bar shows 'Send Correction' (#send-correction-btn) and 'Cancel' (#cancelAuthoringBtn) and no Save or Close button. The editor's note is replaced with 'In the story "ELECTION-POLL" sent at: ... This is a corrected repeat.' (OVERRIDE_EDNOTE_FOR_CORRECTIONS default True); include the editor's note field in the crop if it is in view. Never click Send Correction: it publishes a correction and changes the seeded data for later shots.
